newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi to delist from six Japan bourses -- paper.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi to delist from six Japan bourses -- paper.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp is considering delisting its shares from six regional bourses in Japan as part of cost-cutting measures, Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Wednesday.
The company's shares will continue to be listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Osaka Securities Exchange, the paper said.
It said the company would be able to save more than 100 million yen a year through the move.
A spokesman for the company was not immediately available for comment.
